raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"Leaving Pont Neuf behind, head for Notre-Dame Cathedral, about an 18-minute walk away.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The same Revolution that destroyed Henri IV's statue tore the cathedral's kings down too.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"You're out on the wide square now, the whole west front of Notre-Dame filling the view.","source_id":"795e33c7-62ec-45bf-8924-1f7da57be4c7","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"This is the symbolic heart of France.","source_id":"795e33c7-62ec-45bf-8924-1f7da57be4c7","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Set in the pavement by the west door is a small bronze star called kilometre zero, the point every main road in France measures its distance from.","source_id":"795e33c7-62ec-45bf-8924-1f7da57be4c7","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The square itself is the Parvis, from the old word for paradise.","source_id":"795e33c7-62ec-45bf-8924-1f7da57be4c7","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Haussmann laid it out in the 1860s.","source_id":"795e33c7-62ec-45bf-8924-1f7da57be4c7","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Look down, and white blocks in the stone trace the little medieval streets and houses that once crowded here.","source_id":"795e33c7-62ec-45bf-8924-1f7da57be4c7","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The facade in front of you is the cathedral's most impressive exterior feature.","source_id":"95354cf4-b2c6-4efe-8be6-16049d093bba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"You can still read the Romanesque in its solid H-shape, yet the whole thing feels light and graceful, thanks to the filigree of the central rose window and the gallery above it.","source_id":"95354cf4-b2c6-4efe-8be6-16049d093bba","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Beneath that rose window runs a row of twenty-seven huge figures — the biblical kings, ancestors of Christ.","source_id":"8b453722-4367-424e-a58b-c452f6efaa9b","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"During the Revolution, crowds mistook these Old Testament kings for the kings of France and destroyed them, so the ones you see now are copies.","source_id":"8b453722-4367-424e-a58b-c452f6efaa9b","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1,"also_cites":["58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f"]},{"text":"Over the central doorway, the carving to find is the Day of Judgement.","source_id":"f9fffe53-2022-411b-88a8-261f806e19d6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"In the lower frieze the dead climb from their graves, while Christ above sends the saved to his right, to heaven, and the damned to his left, to hell.","source_id":"f9fffe53-2022-411b-88a8-261f806e19d6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"All around the arch, small angels peer out, alert and mischievous, said to be modelled on the cathedral's own choirboys.","source_id":"f9fffe53-2022-411b-88a8-261f806e19d6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"From the island the whole thing rises like a great ship, moored by huge flying buttresses.","source_id":"58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"It stands on older layers of worship — first a Merovingian church called St-Etienne.","source_id":"58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Under that lay a Roman temple to Jupiter.","source_id":"58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Work began in 1160 under Bishop de Sully and dragged on until about 1345.","source_id":"58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"By then its seminaries had turned out six popes across the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, though it later slipped behind rival sees like Rheims and St-Denis.","source_id":"58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"In time the building fell into decline — then Napoleon gave it back some prestige, crowning himself emperor here in 1804, on walls so shabby they had to be draped in cloth to look grand enough.","source_id":"58756a99-4b2f-47ff-acef-d815518d628f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"And under the square, a crypt holds Gallo-Roman walls, an old quay, a hypocaust, and medieval cellars — two thousand years of history stacked beneath your feet.","source_id":"82edc190-920e-47b0-9b5c-69a2ba678e28","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Back at the eastern end of the Pont-Neuf stand red-brick seventeenth-century houses, across from the Henri IV statue.","source_id":"4b8ecfe7-21e2-4cc7-a05c-e0485a7445a4","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"They frame the entrance to place Dauphine, one of the city's most secluded and attractive squares.","source_id":"4b8ecfe7-21e2-4cc7-a05c-e0485a7445a4","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"That's the walk — Notre-Dame, the symbolic heart of France.","source_id":"GLUE_CLOSING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1}]}
